caseName: Daily Pantagraph, Inc. v. United States
caseNameFull: Daily Pantagraph, Inc. v. United States
attorneys: Mr. Arnold L. Guesmer submitted for petitioner. Solicitor General Thacher, Assistant Attorney General Rugg and Messrs. Claude R. Branch, Special Assistant to the Attorney General, Bradley B. Gilman, and Erwin N. Griswold submitted for the United States.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

On confession of error by the respondent, the United States, the judgment is reversed so far as it relates to the question of the. reduction of invested capital by reason of dividends paid, being the question under review by this Court.
